hooks.command:
python3 -c 'import json,sys,shlex,re
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
c=d.get("tool_input",{}).get("command","")
try:
 t=shlex.split(c) if ("git" in c and "commit" in c) else []
except Exception:
 t=[]
m=[t[i+1] for i in range(len(t)-1) if t[i] in ("-m","--message","-F","--file")]
m+=[x.split("=",1)[1] for x in t if x.startswith(("--message=","--file="))]
m+=[x[2:] for x in t if x.startswith("-m") and len(x)>2 and not x.startswith("--")]
j=" ".join(m)
ok=bool(t) and bool(re.search("claude|anthropic",j,re.I))
print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit message references a forbidden term. Commit/PR messages must not mention coding agents per your standing rule. Rewrite the message without those terms."}}) if ok else "{}")'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking commit message for forbidden terms
